short.headline: 11.8 MILLION VIEWS
short.text: Eleven point eight million views. That's Kai Cenat's first GTA 6 stream on YouTube, and it's number one.
short.text_es: Once coma ocho millones de vistas. Es el primer stream de GTA 6 de Kai Cenat en YouTube, y es el número uno.

short.headline: #2 TGG · #3 TYPICAL GAMER
short.text: Number two is TGG with nine point two million. Number three, Typical Gamer, with seven point one million.
short.text_es: El número dos es TGG con nueve coma dos millones. El tres, Typical Gamer, con siete coma uno millones.

short.headline: #4 DALEK · #5 JYNXZI
short.text: Then MrDalekJD with three point three million, and Jynxzi with two point nine million.
short.text_es: Luego MrDalekJD con tres coma tres millones, y Jynxzi con dos coma nueve millones.
